1. (Currently amended) A method of analyzing one or more plant embryos comprising: (a) collecting shed cellular material from one or more embryos by agitating the one or more embryos in a non-destructive medium __that does not substantially impair embryo viability__; (b) obtaining DNA from the shed cellular material; (c) performing a molecular analysis of the DNA obtained in step (b); and (d) germinating at least one of said one or more embryos __after completion of step (c)__.

2. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 wherein the non-destructive medium consists essentially of water __and wherein the embryos are agitated for a period of time sufficient to release cellular material without substantially damaging embryo tissue__.

3. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 wherein the DNA is obtained by __a multi-step process comprising__ exposing the shed cellular material to cold and then heat followed by agitation.

4. (Previously presented) The method of claim 3 wherein said cold, heat, and agitation steps are repeated.

5. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 wherein the DNA is obtained by heating of the shed cellular material and agitation __wherein the heating is performed at a temperature and duration that does not substantially denature the DNA__.

6. (Previously presented) The method of claim 5 wherein said heat and agitation steps are repeated.

7. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 wherein DNA is obtained by incubating the shed cellular material with __a cell wall degrading__ enzyme.

8. (Previously presented) The method of claim 7 wherein the enzyme is VISCOZYME@.

9. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 [[Error! Reference source not found.]] wherein obtaining DNA from the shed cellular material comprises __isolating and purifying__ the DNA.

10. (Currently amended) The method of claim 9, wherein said [[extracting]] __isolating and purifying__ is performed by adding magnetic particles to the shed cellular material __and applying a magnetic field to separate the DNA-bound particles from the cellular material__.

11. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 wherein the one or more embryos comprise one or more immature embryos __at the time of collection of shed cellular material in step (a)__.

12. (Previously presented) The method of claim 1 further comprising storing the one or more embryos prior to step (c) or (d).

13. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1, wherein said molecular analysis is __performed on DNA obtained from the shed cellular material and__ comprises genotyping.

14. (Previously presented) The method of claim 13, wherein said genotyping occurs by way of: single nucleotide polymorphism detection, restriction fragment length polymorphism identification, random amplified polymorphic detection, amplified fragment length polymorphism detection, DNA sequencing, whole genome sequencing, allele specific oligonucleotide probes, or DNA hybridization to DNA microarrays or beads.

15. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 further comprising growing a germinated embryo into a plant and phenotyping the plant __wherein the phenotyping is performed after germination of the embryo__.

16. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 wherein prior to said molecular analysis, __amplification of the DNA is performed by__ whole genome amplification.

17. (Currently amended) The method of claim 13 further comprising selecting one or more embryos based on __the genotype determined in step (c)__, wherein the selection occurs __prior to germination in step (d)__.

18. (Previously presented) The method of claim 17 further comprising germinating the one or more selected embryos.

19. (Currently amended) The method of claim 18 wherein any of the steps resulting in selection of one or more embryos __or the germination of the selected embryos__ is automated.
